models_evaluated: Hospital ED triage sepsis ML model
Hospital ED triage stroke ML model

links.outcome: Performance of ED-triage ML models when extended to prehospital EMS data
links.effect: Majority-of-predictions sepsis model: 68% sensitivity, 86% specificity, F1 0.33; stroke model: 71% sensitivity, 94% specificity, F1 0.34. Feasible but modest, with a sensitivity-specificity trade-off across prediction rules.
links.quote: The "majority of predictions" model for sepsis demonstrated 68% sensitivity and 86% specificity (+LR: 5, -LR: 0.4; accuracy: 85%, F1: 0.33).

unlisted_practices: Applying serial-prediction aggregation rules (majority vs any prediction) to tune sensitivity/specificity
Incorporating free-text narratives into ML models

screen.reason: Retrospective study evaluating the transferability/performance of hospital ED triage predictive models to prehospital EMS data without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
